question: Should CodexBar add this native share-card surface, and should its totals include every visible account or only an explicitly labeled active-account subset?
rationale: VISION.md requires sign-off for this new product surface, while the implementation exposes an account-scope contract that code review cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor account-complete sharing
options.body: Approve the feature after it uses all visible-account snapshots and includes redacted real-app proof.

options.title: Approve active-account scope
options.body: Permit one active account per provider only if the card and copied text explicitly disclose that narrower scope and tests cover it.

options.title: Decline the share surface
options.body: Close the draft if social-card export is not a product surface CodexBar wants to maintain.

recommendation.title: Sponsor account-complete sharing
recommendation.body: Approve the feature after it uses all visible-account snapshots and includes redacted real-app proof.

likelyOwner.reason: VISION.md assigns this class of feature to sign-off, and steipete merged the central account-model work the decision must preserve.
